Class MenuModel

java.lang.Object
model.MenuModel
public class MenuModel extends Object
Model class for managing menu-related data, including drinks, toppings, and their ingredients.

    • add_drink

      public boolean add_drink(String name, BigDecimal price, String type, boolean hot_available, boolean non_caffeinated, List<Integer> ingredient_ids)
      Adds a new drink to the menu along with its associated ingredients.
      Parameters:
      name - the name of the drink
      price - the price of the drink
      type - the type of drink (eg. milk tea, fruit tea, etc.)
      hot_available - whether the drink is available hot
      non_caffeinated - whether the drink is non-caffeinated
      ingredient_ids - a list of ingredient IDs to associate with the drink
      Returns:
      true if the drink was successfully added, false otherwise

    • update_drink

      Parameters:
      drink_id - the ID of the drink to update
      name - the name of the drink
      price - the price of the drink
      type - the type of drink (eg. milk tea, fruit tea, etc.)
      hot_available - whether the drink is available hot
      non_caffeinated - whether the drink is non-caffeinated
      ingredient_ids - a list of ingredient IDs to associate with the drink
      Returns:
      true if the drink was successfully updated, false otherwise

      public List<String> get_drink_names_by_type(String type)
      Retrieves a list of drink names filtered by the specified type. This is used for the cashier side to populate the drink buttons based on the selected type.
      Parameters:
      type - the type of drinks to retrieve (e.g., "milk tea", "fruit tea")
      Returns:
      a list of drink names matching the specified type
